lures.name: Feathers
lures.say: A pair of small feathers and a spoon. Bonito, barracuda, skipjack, mackerel. Tow them at 5 to 7 kt.

lures.name: Plugs
lures.say: A cedar plug and a diving plug. Yellowtail, dorado, tuna. Tow them at 6 to 9 kt.

lures.name: Marlin lure
lures.say: One big skirted lure, well back. Marlin, and now and then a tuna or a dorado. 7 to 9 kt, and a long wait.

rigs.name: Live bait
rigs.say: A live sardine from the bait barge. Nearly everything eats it, and it is the only way for halibut. One bait a bite.

rigs.name: The iron
rigs.say: A heavy jig, cast or dropped and wound back. Needs no bait. Bonito, barracuda, yellowtail, and bass at a pinch.

rigs.name: Squid on the bottom
rigs.say: A strip of frozen squid on a dropper loop. Needs no live bait. Sheephead, whitefish, rockfish, sculpin, croaker.
